provider_binding.binding: ElevenLabs current-agent variable-name gate observed 2026-08-28; v1.3 separates source-required, compiler-defaulted, optional and production-only semantics.
does_not_prove: provider upload acceptance beyond the validated header/value contract
live-call readiness, conversation quality, booking success, or business outcome

classification_semantics.INTERNAL_RECORD: Preserved audit/business trace. It may be blank without blocking ElevenLabs upload readiness or the production prerequisite gate unless another classified runtime field is derived from it.
classification_semantics.EL_RUNTIME_REQUIRED: No safe generic default exists. The field must be non-empty before a v1.3 CSV is considered ElevenLabs-upload-ready.
classification_semantics.EL_RUNTIME_DEFAULTED: The compiler must materialize a non-empty value from verified evidence or a deterministic non-factual/fail-closed fallback. Missing after compilation blocks ElevenLabs upload readiness.
classification_semantics.OPTIONAL: Helpful when known. Blank is valid and must never block ElevenLabs upload readiness or the production prerequisite gate.
classification_semantics.PRODUCTION_GATE_ONLY: Authoritative Campaign/CRM/Compliance/Meeting input required for the Pixelkiez production prerequisite gate, but not for ElevenLabs CSV upload readiness. Never fabricate these values merely to complete a row.

readiness_semantics.elevenlabs_upload_ready: Structural/type checks pass and every EL_RUNTIME_REQUIRED plus EL_RUNTIME_DEFAULTED field is non-empty after compiler defaults.
readiness_semantics.production_prerequisite_gate: Every PRODUCTION_GATE_ONLY field is supplied by an authorized source and the existing fail-closed compliance consistency checks pass.
readiness_semantics.optional_and_internal: Blank OPTIONAL or INTERNAL_RECORD fields never block ElevenLabs upload readiness.
readiness_semantics.customer_email: OPTIONAL; absence never blocks ElevenLabs upload readiness.
readiness_semantics.unknown_prospect: prospect_name is EL_RUNTIME_DEFAULTED with a non-spoken sentinel; an unknown human name never blocks upload readiness.
